description: Live price for one property and one stay. stay_total includes cleaning, fees and taxes; nightly rates exclude them. Also returns the refundable deposit hold, which is separate from the total, the payment schedule, and that home's own cancellation and check-in terms. The top-level totals and cancellation are the non-refundable rate; rate_options lists every rate on offer with its own terms, total and booking_url, including a refundable rate with its free-cancellation deadline when check-in is more than 30 days away. Returns a booking_url the guest opens to complete the booking and accept the rental terms on Luxury Lodging's own site; this tool does not book or take payment. Amounts ending in _minor are integer cents in `currency`.

guests.description: Everyone staying, including children and infants.

pets.description: How many pets the guest is bringing, 0 to 4; 0 or leave out for none. true means one pet and false none. This changes the price: some homes charge per pet or per pet per night.

name: get_live_quote

outputSchema.description: A live total for one stay. When available is false only property_id, available, reason, booking_url and a short quote block are present.

cancellation.description: This home's own cancellation terms for the non-refundable rate, which stay_total prices. Each entry in rate_options carries its own terms, and those are the only refund terms that apply to that rate.

payment_schedule.description: When the guest pays. plan 'deposit': due_at_booking now and the balance charged automatically to the same card on balance_charged_on (60 days before check-in). plan 'full': everything at booking.

pets.description: How many pets this quote is for. pet_fee in price_breakdown is the fee for that many.

refundable_rate_premium.description: The 8% of the nightly subtotal the refundable rate adds; 0 on the non-refundable rate.

taxes.description: Lodging tax. It is collected on every stay and included in the total.

quote.description: The authoritative, machine-readable quote for this stay, for the rate stay_total prices (the non-refundable rate). Amounts ending in _minor are integer cents in `currency`. total_stay_price_minor is exactly what the guest is charged in total, including taxes and the card processing fee, and the amounts add up: total_stay_price_minor = nightly_subtotal_minor + mandatory_fees_minor + optional_fees_minor + taxes_minor + card_fee_minor - discounts_minor. When available is false only availability_status, inventory_held, checked_at, canonical_url, incomplete and missing are present. The itemised _minor amounts are null only when missing includes price_breakdown.

cancellation_policy_id.description: The rate this quote prices; rate_options lists both.

canonical_url.description: The home's property page, not the booking link.

card_fee_minor.description: The 3.5% card processing fee, added at checkout and included in the total.

charges.description: Every charge, itemised. The amounts of the rows with paid_at checkout add up to total_stay_price_minor exactly; a discount row is negative.

paid_at.description: checkout: part of the total. outside_checkout: not part of it (the security hold).

checked_at.description: When this quote was fetched, ISO 8601.

discounts_minor.description: A positive amount subtracted from the total; 0 when there is none.

due_later_minor.description: The rest, charged automatically to the same card 60 days before check-in; 0 when everything is due now.

due_now_minor.description: Charged when the guest books: 50% of the total when check-in is more than 60 days away, otherwise all of it.

expires_at.description: When the quote lapses, ISO 8601; the same instant as quote_expires_at.

incomplete.description: True when a required input or tax could not be determined; missing says which.

inventory_held.description: False: a quote does not hold the home.

mandatory_fees_minor.description: Cleaning and every other required fee.

missing.description: rent_tax_rate: the provider's fee table could not be read, so the refundable rate cannot be priced. price_breakdown: the provider sent only a total. line_items_mismatch: the itemised charges add up to more than the total.

nightly_subtotal_minor.description: Rent for the nights before any discount, plus the refundable-rate premium when that rate is quoted.

optional_fees_minor.description: Fees the guest chose, the pet fee for the pets in this quote.

quote_id.description: Stable id for this priced stay: the same home, dates, guests, pets, rate and total give the same id; any change gives a new one. Not a hold or a reservation.

refundable.description: True when the rate this quote prices can be cancelled for a refund until its free-cancellation deadline; false for the non-refundable rate.

refundable_security_hold_minor.description: A refundable hold on the card on file, separate from the total. The home's own amount, or the standard hold when it states none.

tax_source.description: Where the tax comes from: the provider's own quote, or our verified rate table for the home's jurisdiction when the provider's quote had none. Either way the tax is collected and in the total.

taxes_included.description: True: the total includes lodging tax, which is collected on every stay.

timezone.description: IANA zone of the home: the provider's own zone when it states one, otherwise the zone of the home's US state (timezone_source says which). Null when unknown.

total_stay_price_minor.description: The whole price of the stay, equal to stay_total in cents.

quote_expires_at.description: When this quote lapses. After it, the price of the stay can differ from stay_total until it is quoted again.

rate_options.description: Every rate on offer for this stay. The first is the non-refundable rate (the same totals as the top level). When check-in is more than 30 days away a refundable rate follows: 8% more on the nightly subtotal, taxed as rent, cancellable for a full refund of everything paid until free_cancel_until. Each rate has its own booking_url.

free_cancel_until.description: Refundable rate only. The last instant, in UTC, the stay can be cancelled for a full refund.

refundable.description: True when this rate can be cancelled for a refund until free_cancel_until; false when a confirmed reservation cannot be cancelled for a refund.

reason.description: Why the stay cannot be booked. Only present when available is false.

security_deposit_hold.description: A refundable hold, not part of stay_total.

stay_total.description: The price of the stay, including cleaning, fees and taxes. Nightly rates exclude them.

total_due_now.description: What the guest pays at booking: the whole stay_total, or 50% of it when check-in is more than 60 days away; payment_schedule says which.

title: Get a live total price
